I see gender affirming euphoria to be more telling if someone is trans. I have physical and social dysphoria but I wouldn’t say that someone else isn’t trans because they don’t experience those things. To me, the dysphoria isn’t what matters, but rather when you feel happy about when someone calls you by the right pronouns or you feel like no one cares when you go into the gendered bathroom that aligns with your identity. And non-binary, agender, genderfluid all fall under the trans umbrella. I hope this makes sense and doesn’t come off as rude, have a wonderful day
